notes: MAINT-MAPS stories defined per required breakdown.

stories.title: Map Data Schema and Marker Contract
stories.description: Define frontend data contract for rendering providers on map including latitude, longitude, provider name, specialty, and identifier. Ensure compatibility with provider search outputs.
stories.evidence: Website/architecture.html (frontend mapping capability referenced in manifest)

stories.title: Map Rendering Core Logic
stories.description: Implement core logic to initialize map component, center based on provider results, and render provider markers using the defined schema.
stories.evidence: Website/architecture.html (frontend mapping capability referenced in manifest)

stories.title: Map UI Integration in Find Care Flow
stories.description: Integrate map component into existing frontend alongside provider search results, ensuring synchronized updates when search results change.
stories.evidence: Website/architecture.html (frontend mapping capability referenced in manifest)

stories.title: Provider Interaction and Marker Details
stories.description: Enable user interaction with map markers including click-to-view provider summary (name, specialty, location) and highlight corresponding list item.
stories.evidence: Website/architecture.html (frontend mapping capability referenced in manifest)

stories.title: Map Rendering Tests and Integration Validation
stories.description: Create unit and integration tests validating marker rendering, map initialization, and synchronization with provider results.
stories.evidence: Website/architecture.html (frontend mapping capability referenced in manifest)

per_feature.mitigation: Use established frontend map libraries and limit scope to basic marker rendering.
